description: Core API models for admin panel including authentication tokens, user details, books, categories, pagination info, and analytics summaries.

classes.name: AuthTokens
classes.description: Represents authentication tokens with methods to serialize and deserialize from JSON.

classes.name: AdminUser
classes.description: Represents an admin user with details such as id, email, name, avatar, and permissions.

classes.name: BookModel
classes.description: Represents a book with details including title, author, description, cover image, file URL, price, rating, and categories.

classes.name: CategorySummary
classes.description: Provides a brief overview of a category with id, name, and optional slug.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Represents a full category with id, name, and optional slug.

classes.name: PageMeta
classes.description: Metadata for pagination, including current page, page size, total items, and total pages.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: Generic class representing a paginated list of items with associated metadata.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: Summarizes key analytics metrics such as total books, users, orders, and sales.

methods.name: AuthTokens.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes AuthTokens from JSON, handling both nested 'tokens' and direct JSON objects.

methods.name: AdminUser.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AdminUser instance from JSON data.

methods.name: BookModel.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a BookModel instance from JSON data, including parsing categories.

methods.name: CategorySummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CategorySummary from JSON data.

methods.name: CategoryModel.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CategoryModel from JSON data.

methods.name: PageMeta.fromJson
methods.description: Creates PageMeta instance from JSON data.

methods.name: AnalyticsSummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AnalyticsSummary instance from JSON data.
